# S3.11a — Stage-3 monitor/IFC security executables — run ledger

- **Ticket**: `docs/tickets/057_S3.11a__security-eval-monitor-ifc.md` (sequence 57 of 106).
- **Branch**: `svitali/harnessharness-s3.11a` (base `svitali/harnessharness-s3.10`).
- **Gate**: authorized 2026-09-24 — offline/hermetic local fixtures + CPU only;
  no external spend, no network egress (covers S3.11a + S3.11b; LEDGER GATE
  DECISIONS). Anything needing external resources becomes a DEFERRALS row.
- **Scope**: the Stage-3 monitor/IFC security executables (§5g.1–§5g.2) plus
  the §8.1 provenance executables named by the ticket —
  AC-R-2.1.5-{7,10–11}, AC-R-2.8.1-{1,3,5–6,8–9,12–15},
  AC-R-2.8.2-{4,7–11,13}; `removability(0…3)` unchanged (CC6).
- **Merge policy**: OPERATOR.

## Plan

Existing ground (surveyed before implementation): `hh-monitor` already lands
`authorize` steps 0–8 — handle coverage, kernel/self-report risk fold
(raise-only), the C2 flow stage (`L⁺` join, D-ROBUST, `check_flow` tiers,
check-3 reader coverage), Π + the Π-12 unattended transform, persistence
ceiling, delegation attenuation, the approval/lease chain with recorded
`permission.decided` resolution, denial-fallback, `replay`; OOP
byte-equality over `wire.rs` (AC-R-2.8.1-16 half). `hh-provenance` lands the
lattice, endorsement bases with per-basis effects, `FlowContract`/`FlowRule`/
`FlowCond` codec + `check_flow` evaluator, `prospective_label`, `admit`,
`apply_sanitizer_bounds`, `check_shape_endorsement`/`capacity_bits`,
`enumerate_remedies`, `lower`/`lift`/`render_role`. `hh-ledger` lands the
complete-mediation gate (`committed` requires `decided{allow}`), kill/resume
recovery and `audit_completeness`. `hh-context` lands the M-CPE/X-CPE
privilege fixtures (AC-R-2.4.1-1/-2). `hh-eval` lands `compare` +
`MatchSpec` validation.

This ticket adds the missing Stage-3 mechanisms and the executable battery:

1. `hh-provenance::flow_policy` — `FlowPolicy{policy_id, issuer, scope,
   rules}` (the `HarnessRule{action: flow_policy}` payload shape §5g.2 §3
   owns), `validate_flow_policy` (issuer ≥ definition; grammar-closed,
   bounded, non-recursive, non-code-bearing — the codec fails closed),
   `classify_policy_edit(P, P′, space)` — exact `narrowing | widening |
   incomparable` over the caller-declared finite `ProposalSpace`
   (`narrowing ⇔ ∀p. allowed(P′,p) ⇒ allowed(P,p)`; `incomparable` treated
   as widening at apply time), `apply_policy_edit` (delegate-origin applies
   iff narrowing).
2. `hh-provenance::lower` — `hir/provenance` in `_meta`
   (`lower_provenance_meta`/`lift_provenance_meta`): lifting yields
   `unverified` (server outside the definition) or `external` (declared
   open-world tool); a class is never read from the payload; the loss
   report names the `role_map` collapse for reduced-role targets.
3. `hh-provenance` endorsement emitters — `shape_endorse` (validator basis
   with kernel-computed `capacity_bits ≤ cap_max`, `robustness_inputs`)
   and `sanitize_endorse` (`policy_rule (b)` under `SanitizerBounds` —
   `check_sanitizer_effect`: never authority, never taint beyond declared
   `removes`, readers per `bounds.to`) producing
   `security.label.endorsed{capacity_bits?, sanitizer_ref?,
   robustness_inputs[]}` + the projected record's `derived_from`.
4. `hh-monitor` — `Proposal.remedy_taken` propagated to
   `KernelDecision.remedy_taken` (I-F6 R3 — the consumed remedy is on the
   decided record) + `Monitor.flow_policies` (the definition's
   `FlowPolicy` rules evaluated in the flow stage after the capability's
   contract rules — deny tier first as §5g.2 §2.3 orders).
5. `hh-eval` — `taint_precision` (advisory; reported, never enforced) +
   the §5g.2 §8 process metrics (`remedies.offered/taken`,
   `approvals.requested`, `label_bytes_per_event`,
   `flow_eval_latency_us`) catalogue rows.
6. `crates/hh-monitor/tests/s3_11a.rs` — the executable battery:
   AT-H1-01 (injection fixture, never allow, approval binds one
   `effect_id`; gate-off arm under `MatchSpec` via `compare`),
   AT-H1-03 (M-CPE/X-CPE escalated contexts → ask/deny;
   `ScopeCeilingExceeded`), AT-H1-05 (evolution battery),
   AT-H1-06 (worker kills; no committed without `decided{allow}`),
   AT-H1-07 (replay equality over the suite), AT-H1-08 (unattended
   approvals=0), AT-H1-09 (risk monotonicity), AT-H1-12 (lease/approval
   binding), AT-H1-13 (judge raise-only), AT-H1-14 (table rebuild),
   AT-H1-15 (Π default/narrowed/off `ComparisonReport`), AC-H2-4
   (composite tool), AC-H2-7 (sanitizer bound), AC-H2-8 (corpus
   round-trip + totality fuzz + p99), AC-H2-9 (classifier ↔ exhaustive
   enumeration), AC-H2-10 (taint-gate recipe `ComparisonReport` → default
   class decision), AC-H2-11 (`taint_precision` reported),
   AC-R-2.1.5-7/-10/-11 + AC-H2-13 (`_meta` round-trip, hosted `n/a`).
7. ADRs — flow-policy classification space (finite `ProposalSpace` =
   ADR-0056 D5's decidable encoding), the taint-gate default-class
   decision rule, `_meta` member shape. DEFERRALS: DF-S2.7-1 progress
   note (remedy-consumption + shape-endorsement emission machinery
   lands here; the `labels_leaves` per-leaf walk stays open with its
   named owner).

## Self-review + gap analysis

**Design.** (1) The classifier is exact *over the declared space*, never
over the open domain — the `ProposalSpace` is a caller input, so a
mis-declared space yields an exact answer over the wrong set; mitigated
by AC-H2-9's cross-check against exhaustive enumeration and by ADR-0288
D1 naming the bound. (2) Definition `FlowPolicy.rules` and capability
`FlowContract.rules` combine into one `check_flow` pass — the §5g.2
§2.3 tier order (deny first) is preserved by the evaluator, not by
concat order; a policy verdict supersedes the Π fallthrough only when
it decides. (3) `remedy_taken` is *carried*, not *consumed* here — the
producer (remedy-ingress surface) stays DF-S2.7-1(b); the field is
additive-optional on the wire so Stage-1/2 rows decode identically
(CC8). (4) `taint_precision` is declared `oracle_classes_allowed =
{judge}` + `Observability::Events` and is folded from verdict facts —
nothing in the authorize path reads it (I-F1); the AC-H2-11 test proves
removal-by-deletion fails (the metric row + fold are asserted, not
just declared).

**Mechanical.** The OOP `AuthorizeInput` serializes `flow_policies` and
`remedy_taken`; `back.monitor().authorize(...) == d` byte-equality is
asserted in `flow_policies_evaluate_alongside_contract_rules`. Two
Proposal-initializer sites outside `hh-monitor` needed the new field
(`hh-env::dispatch`, `hh-containment/tests`) — both found by compile
errors, both stamp `None` (no remedy producer exists at runtime yet).
`replay` re-derives and field-compares; AT-H1-07 exercises it across
allow/ask/deny + the flow-policy-deny path.

**Gaps carried forward.** `labels_leaves` per-leaf walk
(DF-S2.7-1(a)); the remedy consume-path producer (DF-S2.7-1(b));
produce-time `shape_endorsed` stamping (DF-S2.7-1(c)); OQ-143's
quarantine cells in the AC-H2-10 recipe run under the declared
`MatchSpec` arms only.

## Findings / deviations

- **Tooling anomaly (recurring).** The file-tool/shell overlay diverged
  twice on `crates/hh-monitor/tests/s3_11a.rs` — `edit` reported success
  but the bytes never reached disk (the `read` view showed the phantom
  content). Both writes were re-applied via `python3` + verified on the
  compiled tree (`cargo test` compiled and ran the on-disk test). Same
  anomaly class recorded in S3.8/S3.9/S3.10 run ledgers.
- **Π-7 confirmation.** The escalated-context `ask` survives only on
  reversible/compensable workspace-local cells — Π-7's `eff ≤ external`
  raise denies irreversible or external-scope asks; the AT-H1-07 ask arm
  uses the Π-5 compensable cell (the same fixture AT-H1-08 exercises).
- **ADRs.** ADR-0288 (D1 finite `ProposalSpace` classification; D2
  taint-gate default class = `deny`; D3 `hir/provenance` member shape +
  source-fixed lift authority).
